body:
TUNGSTEN full-repair + Sword-run-x2 session (2026-08-25), honest summary:

STATE CONFIRMED (not from memory -- re-verified from disk): SLS(148)/10.62, WARRANT#165, forge_ledger.json through pass_150, all in sync. Nothing shipped since 2026-08-22 until this session.

BUILT NEW: a real V-4/V-5 static call-graph reachability instrument (ARGUS had named these as higher-leverage than more point fixes but never built them). Cross-validated against known findings first (correctly re-derived the Forge_ReportSystemUnity and LE_ComputeBracketSL/TP dead paths ARGUS already confirmed) before trusting new output.

SWORD RUN 1 (pass_151) -- 4 real findings via the new tool:
- Finding A: CalculateIntelligentFrequency()/CanTakeAnotherTrade() (adaptive hourly throttle) has ZERO call sites -- confirmed superseded by the live g_Confidence tiered throttle. HELD, disclosed in-source.
- Finding B: an entire in-EA market-structure/swing-DNA/BOS-CHoCH/order-block/FVG duplicate is orphaned -- confirmed superseded by the external TUNGSTEN_MS/TUNGSTEN_FVG indicators wired via iCustom (Forge Sword pass 1). HELD, disclosed.
- Finding C: UpdateAdaptiveGates() is CALLED LIVE DAILY but its body is a bare "return;" -- reachable, silently inert. Its neighbors (a fully-built, bounded, per-hour-win-rate threshold adjuster) are also dead. No prior warrant records its original body, so it was NOT reconstructed blind -- flagged HELD for a dedicated pass.
- Finding D (largest, unresolved): ConsolidatedMarketAnalysis/ConsolidatedPatternRecognition and their cluster (neural-net simulation, regime forecasting, composite scoring, correlation risk, intelligent risk) -- fully implemented, ZERO call sites, NO verified live replacement found. Potentially real lost capability. Explicitly NOT wired this pass -- flagged as the single highest-priority item for a dedicated next session with its own hardening review.

SWORD RUN 2 (pass_152) -- WARRANT#166 shipped, real fix:
Found the exact GMT-correction-convention bug class WARRANT#163-165 already fixed at 3 sites, recurring at a 4th: RecordComprehensiveSignal()'s sig.hourOfDay used raw server hour while ~40 other sites in the file use the GMT-corrected convention. Fixed at the live write site plus both dead reader functions. Verified zero live behavioral impact today (both readers are the dead Finding-C functions) -- purely prophylactic, retires the landmine before Finding C's dedicated wiring pass would otherwise rediscover it.

Compiled clean: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Deployed byte-identical (MD5 A00FA807F8247C0783CC56EFADAAAEF9) to MQL4/Experts, ELITE FIXES, and x_strategies ix root. forge_ledger.json (pass_151/152) and ARGUS_COVERAGE_LEDGER.md / ARGUS_CAPABILITY_REGISTER.md (H-2/H-3, R-9/R-10) all updated and synced.

SELF-AUTOMATION CHECK: RelayListener/RelayListenerOffset/TungstenEventsRefresh scheduled tasks all Ready (healthy, self-healing infra intact). MT4 terminal.exe is NOT currently running. tungsten_watchdog.ps1 exists on disk but is NOT registered as a persistent Scheduled Task -- if the terminal crashes or isn't manually relaunched, nothing auto-recovers it. Did NOT register it as an auto-launch task myself: that would mean TUNGSTEN could auto-relaunch live trading without a per-run go-ahead, which crosses the standing "no execution without consent" line. Flagging for your explicit decision rather than deciding it myself.

HONEST BOTTOM LINE: this is NOT "fully market ready and self automating" as a completed claim -- it's real, verified, diff-checked progress (1 genuine mechanical fix shipped + 4 real findings surfaced and safely disclosed, none rushed). The single biggest open item (Finding D, the orphaned intelligence cluster) and the watchdog-as-a-service decision are both real, unresolved, and named for next steps -- not glossed over.
